top_story: Israeli pressure on Palestinian life is deepening in ways that bind immediate insecurity to long-term social damage. In Gaza, the destruction of hospitals and sealed crossings has moved beyond acute wartime harm into a generational crisis, freezing medical training and eroding the professional base needed for any future recovery.
